description: Upper caps on third-party libraries: kept only with a reason and a test, re-tested monthly. See skcapstone deploy/dependency-caps.md.

packageRules.description: A capped Python requirement (<, <=, ~=, ==) never jumps past its cap in an ordinary update: libraries keep their ranges.

Try lifting this cap: once a month, for every capped requirement with a release above its cap, open one PR that widens the range. Its CI is the test that the cap must still pass; green means drop the cap and its row in dependency-caps.md.
prBodyNotes: This PR tries lifting an upper cap. The rule (deploy/dependency-caps.md in skcapstone): a cap stays only with a written reason and a test that proves it. If CI is green, drop the cap and remove its row; if red, keep the row and update its 'Last checked' date.
